effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP until the end of their turn. If you have 3 or fewer, 1 of their Digimon gains ＜Security A. -2＞ (This Digimon checks 2 fewer security cards.) until the end of their turn.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, by trashing the top card of your security stack, unsuspend this Digimon.
